title: Chapter 97
text:
Antonio got out of the car and watched the explosion with Han Xiao. He lit up a cigar and laughed. "I haven't seen such a beautiful scene in a long time. I've been sitting in the office for so long that I've almost forgotten what an explosion looks like."

"Then you can enjoy it."

Han Xiao stretched his neck to relieve the fatigue from the chase.

The fire finally died down. He and Antonio approached the explosion site. A strong, suffocating stench filled the air, mixed with the smell of burnt human bodies and poisonous gas …

Oh my, I forgot about the poisonous gas!

Han Xiao looked at the notification on the interface. He didn't know whether to laugh or cry. He could only retreat and wait for the poisonous gas to dissipate before cleaning up the battlefield.

"Ugh …" A weak moan sounded. The still alive Code 3 slowly crawled out. His limbs were blown apart, and his body was a mixture of red and black. He struggled to raise his head and stared at Han Xiao.

"You … why …"

Han Xiao glanced at him. Without waiting for Code 3 to finish, he took out Berserk Eagle and blew his head off.

The good guys were invincible in talking, and the bad guys died because they talked too much. There were more examples than the stars in the sky. To be honest, there was a moment when the Great Mechanic Han wanted to try and kill himself, but after thinking about it, he felt that he did not look like a good main character, so he directly attacked.

"This wave of EXP is quite good … Three, Five, Nine, what kind of stupid name is that?" Han Xiao looked at the interface with disdain.

Wait a minute, there seemed to be an enemy missing from the kill information.

Han Xiao's eyes flashed. He looked around and suddenly fired at the ground twenty meters away.

Bang! A black shadow jumped out from the sand. Ghostly Fox held a dagger and moved like a ghost. She stabbed the dagger at Antonio, who was closest to her.

The Martial Arts School that she practiced had a simple Earth Burrowing Technique. At the moment of the explosion, she hid in the sand and escaped. She originally wanted to hide, but seeing that Han Xiao had seen through her, she could only fight with her life.

The dagger reflected the sunlight and flashed with a piercing cold light. Antonio narrowed his eyes and reached out with his thick arm. His large hand was like a bear's paw.

Ghostly Fox dodged to the side. Her petite body made it easy for her. She circled behind Antonio and stabbed her dagger at his back. Suddenly, a black shadow enlarged in front of her eyes. A bear-like palm followed her like a shadow and grabbed her head, almost wrapping it around her head.

Antonio threw the Ghostly Fox more than ten meters away as if he was throwing a shot put. The huge force blasted a circle of ripples in the sand. Ghostly Fox's head was bleeding from the fall. She gritted her teeth as her petite body once again pounced forward. With Han Xiao by her side, she would only be killed if she tried to escape. She had no other choice.

"Bang, bang, bang!"

Just as Antonio was about to make a move, Han Xiao fired two guns at the same time, turning Ghost Fox into a sieve.

You have killed Ghost Fox (LV29). You have received 9,400 EXP.

"Eh, its level isn't low. Why is it so fragile?" Han Xiao looked at her battle log and discovered that Ghostly Fox's main class was only Level 8. The rest of her sub-classes were all at the level of her sub-classes. Moreover, her sub-classes were all low-level. It was no wonder that she was so weak.

Antonio said helplessly, "Give me a chance to move my rusty body."

"The corpse is still warm. Go and move around." Han Xiao picked his nose.

"… You're so dirty."

When the poisonous gas dispersed, Han Xiao stepped into the explosion zone and retrieved the EMP jammer buried in the ground.

Han Xiao did not know that E 'Jiu had grasped his movements, but he was used to making multiple plans. That night, he had not only set up one trap but also a total of four traps in different directions. Unless the enemy did not chase after him, he could lure at least one of them into the trap.

As long as you dare to chase after me, I'll kill you.

After putting away the jammer, Han Xiao rummaged through the corpse and found a lot of guns and ammunition. These could all be sold for money. The biggest gain was the modified tank, Thorns. It could be used after the internal electronic components were repaired.

"Now, I can borrow some strength."

…

"Ghostly Fox has lost contact?"

Three assassins in ambush, and they had the advantage of intelligence, but they still fell into the enemy's trap!

Luo Qing's heart was heavy. The previous two teams had failed, and the modified Thorns was gone. Now, the stronghold was defenseless. It was a huge loss.

Once again, Luo Qing contacted his backer and explained the situation in detail.

The person on the other end of the phone said slowly, "You guys retreat first."

"… Understood."

After hanging up, Luo Qing organized his men to move the valuable resources to the vehicles and prepared to abandon the stronghold and retreat temporarily. This was not the first time Rose Militant faced danger. As long as they escaped for a few days, their backer would send more men over. By then, they would be able to regain their foothold.

However, halfway through the transportation of the resources, an ear-piercing alarm sounded in the stronghold.

"Enemy attack!"

The mercenaries on the lookout post let out shrill cries. Luo was startled, and quickly ran to the lookout post. Looking into the distance, he saw a rolling sand dragon rapidly approaching, accompanied by dozens of Gatonian mercenaries' war chariots.

"Damn it, they're too fast!"

Rose Militant's forces were greatly damaged, and they would definitely be targeted by other forces. Gaton was the most likely enemy to take advantage of this situation. Leaving the stronghold was to avoid the hostility of other forces. However, the Gaton mercenaries were too fast. It could only be because someone had tipped them off.

Luo Qing was furious. The Gaton mercenaries were attacking the stronghold from the front. If they drove away recklessly, it would turn into a chase, which would be even more dangerous.

It was impossible to stop halfway!

"Leader, what should we do?"

Luo Qing made up his mind. "Retaliate! Beat them up!"

The mercenaries of Rose Militant put down the resources in their hands and hurriedly returned to their respective fortifications. They controlled their machine guns and howitzers and fired at the Gaton mercenaries. The Gaton mercenaries did not back down and retaliated.

Bullets flew back and forth, forming a deadly barrage.

Countless shell casings fell onto the yellow sand, and many charred craters appeared on the sand like craters on the surface of the moon. Rose Militant's stronghold was well-fortified. Even though they lacked manpower, they were able to withstand Gaton's attack.

Behind the walls of the stronghold, Luo Qing was continuously commanding the mercenaries. Su Li walked over and whispered into his ear, "We're understaffed.

One-fourth of the fortifications are unmanned. We're trapped in the stronghold. If other forces interfere, we'll be in a bad situation. "

As soon as she finished speaking, a loud engine sound came from afar. Luo Qing and Su Li's hearts skipped a beat. They recognized this engine sound!

On the other side of the battlefield, Han Xiao was driving the ferocious-looking Thorns. He leaped down from the sand dune like a ferocious tiger. The car drew an arc in the air. The repaired exterior armor reflected the dazzling sunlight, and the idling wheels spun at an extremely high speed.

The car crashed onto the ground, kicking up a cloud of yellow sand. The car sped up and charged toward the stronghold of Rose Militant with an imposing aura.

"Isn't that the Thorns of Rose Militant?"

Gaton narrowed his eyes and quickly ordered his subordinates to shrink their formation. He had a deep understanding of the firepower of Thorns. He thought that the pilot of Thorns was an enemy, so he was prepared to defend against Thorns from the flank.

However, the people of Rose Militant were even more nervous than him. They knew the firepower of the Thorns better. Su Li shouted, "Stop him quickly! Don't let the Thorns get close to the stronghold!"

Luo Qing felt extremely wronged. The Thorns was their trump card in the past. Now, it was seized by someone else and used against them. What kind of behavior was this? It was like when someone stole your girlfriend, and the bastard even brought your girlfriend … or ex-girlfriend to show off in front of you. How could you tolerate this?
